title: CCP Estimation of Dynamic Discrete Choice Demand Models with Segment Level Data and Continuous Unobserved Heterogeneity: Rethinking EV Subsidies vs. Infrastructure
eligible_reason: Methods paper: CCP estimation of a dynamic discrete choice demand model with segment-level EV sales in Washington State, with counterfactuals on subsidies vs charging infrastructure. Structural estimation only, no DiD.
design_notes: Replication Data/DataGeneratingScript.R builds model inputs from public sources (WA EV registrations, IRS SOI, AFDC stations, CBP); estimation was run in MATLAB/Knitro (estimation code not in the package).
data_files_note: Public source data shipped; gasoline prices from C2ER (licensed) included at county level.
software_notes: R data construction; MATLAB estimation (not shipped).
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
